params.caption: 🎮 CD Projekt Red uses gen-AI to restore Geralt's Polish voice CD Projekt Red has revealed it is using generative AI to treat and adjust the voice of Jacek Rozenek, the Polish actor behind Geralt, after he suffered a stroke. The work is for the upcoming Witcher 3 expansion Songs of the Past, and the studio calls it a way to "use AI ethically". 🕒 Nov 12, 2026 · 17:26 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Eurogamer 👍 React if you think this is fair use · 💬 Where should AI in games draw the line? #Witcher3 #CDProjektRed #GamingNews
